newsitem.title: UK: Centrica up on gas levy abolition.
newsitem.headline: Centrica up on gas levy abolition.

text.p: Shares in Centrica Plc rose in pre-market trade on Thursday as the natural gas supplier was seen as one of the main beneficiaries of Wednesday's UK budget.
The stock was up 2-1/2p at 78-1/2 by 0712 GMT in volume of 250,300 shares.

The company said Chancellor Gordon Brown's abolition of the gas levy -- imposed in 1981 on eight fields in the North Sea and estimated to have totalled 200 million stg in fiscal 1997 -- would cut its costs and help it become more competitive.

The Financial Times Lex column estimated that the move could save Centrica between 700 million stg and 800 million over the next seven or eight years, boosting Centrica's profits by 250 million stg even if two-thirds was passed on to consumers.
